description.value: The Sea to Sky Gondola is a year-round aerial gondola attraction near Squamish, BC, lifting visitors to a mountain summit with sweeping views of Howe Sound and surrounding peaks. At the top, guests can cross a suspension bridge, explore hiking and via ferrata routes, and dine at several on-site restaurants. It sits directly on the Sea to Sky corridor, making it a natural and compelling detour for touring cyclists travelling between Vancouver and Whistler.
